cards.text:
30% Defense-Based Damage × 2.
At the start of the turn, if Voracity was activated 3 or more times in the previous turn, move to hand.
Attunement: 1 Voracity.

cards.text:
50% Defense-Based Damage × 3.

60% Shield.

cards.name: Bottomless Hunger I
cards.text:
3 Voracity.

cards.name: Bottomless Hunger II
cards.text: Decrease Cost of 2 random cards in hand by 1 for 1 turn(s).

cards.name: Bottomless Hunger III
cards.text: When Voracity is activated 3 times in 1 turn, decrease Cost of 1 random card in hand by 1 until used (1 time per turn).

cards.name: Bottomless Hunger IV
cards.text: For 1 turn, +100% Defense-Based Damage.

cards.name: Bottomless Hunger V
cards.text:
7 Voracity.

cards.name: Voluntary Control
cards.text:
If Voracity is fewer than 6 stacks, gain 6 Voracity.
If 6 or more stacks, gain 2 Predation.

cards.name: Voluntary Control I
cards.text:
If Voracity is fewer than 6 stacks, gain 9 Voracity.
If 6 or more stacks, gain 3 Predation.

cards.name: Voluntary Control II
cards.text:
If Mealtime is in Draw Pile, move to hand.

cards.name: Voluntary Control III

cards.name: Voluntary Control IV
cards.text:
10 Voracity.
Select 1 Attack Card(s).
1 Predation each time that card is moved to hand.

cards.name: Voluntary Control V
cards.text:

+50% Damage Amount to Basic Attack Cards.

cards.name: Domain of Voracity II

cards.name: Domain of Voracity III
